[[Ronda Spencer]] - mother |dob =October 23, 2069 |dob verified=yes |location =[[Hollywood Hills]], [[Los Angeles]] |affiliation = |TV actor =[[Mason Cufari]] }} '''Roy Spencer''' is a child living in [[Los Angeles]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== The child of [[Bob Spencer|Bob]] and [[Ronda Spencer]], Roy was born on October 23, 2069, and lived with his family in a large house in [[Hollywood Hills]], Los Angeles. His eighth birthday was on the day of the [[Great War]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== At his birthday party, Roy watches as [[The Ghoul|Cooper Howard]] performs a lasso trick sitting on top of his horse, [[Sugarfoot]]. He then has a picture taken with him on top of Sugarfoot; after that is done, Cooper gently places him on the ground. When it comes time for Cooper to leave, he tells Roy's mother that he wishes Roy a wonderful birthday party. Roy and the other party guests then head to the TV, where a [[weather newscaster]] reports on the upcoming weather. However, the weather newscaster breaks character over his concerns about nuclear war, so Mrs. Spencer changes the station to a ''[[Grognak the Barbarian]]'' cartoon. As the children watch the cartoon on the TV while enjoying their slices of cake, a bomb is dropped in the far away distance, causing the glass wall windows to break and shatter. Immediately after this, Roy's parents take him and flee to the fallout shelter they built beneath their house. ==Appearances== Roy Spencer appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
